notes.title: Explicit Update (14)
notes.notes:
-Reworded/rewrote most of the writings to be more explicit
 +All writings were done in a way to be a lot more explicit (I realized that subtlety is for cowards)
 +Just about every computer has an actionable piece of information
 +If not, it tells you about a specific location in the map
 +If not, they are big reveals or are computers that don't require a password

-Every password computer now has a hint on where to get the password

-Broke open the sky to make the Orange Stairs a clear landmark

-Added signs and environmental details to help with navigation

-Actual interesting things for the second projector

-Replaced an old song with a new one in the VR world

-THE STATIC now looks like how it works in canon

-Many other minor changes

notes.title: STORY+ Update (10)
notes.notes:
-About 90% or more of all the documents/computers/notes have been rewritten
	+All the events of the story have stayed the same with some semi-major changes
	+Some only rewritten, some replaced completely
	+Characters have different beliefs about the simulation
	+Concepts are explained in the world more than just in writings

-Many censored versions of documents have been removed

-NPCs were added to the VR world that you can talk to (with secret messages)

-Headset will be taken out automatically when you are at the correct spots

-Boundaries are easier to draw and cross out with

-There are less out of bounds triggers

-Computers have the input field always selected

-Some passwords have been changed or rearranged

-More objects are able to be deleted/duplicated

-Lots of minor changes to the real world and VR world

-Added a few sound effects and animations

-Some optimization

-Fixed some bugs

-Many other minor changes
